title: Unified flexagent binary with serve subcommands
description:
Implement the unified flexagent binary with serve subcommands, migrating the existing
cmd/sandbox-host into it.

Sections: 7 (Deployment Modes), 7.1-7.4 (Binary, In-Process, Sandbox-Launched, Shutdown),
13 (Package Structure — cmd/flexagent), 17 Q1 (binary decision)

Key deliverables:
- cmd/flexagent/main.go — Unified binary entry point with subcommand routing
- cmd/flexagent/serve_agent.go — 'flexagent serve agent' subcommand: starts AgentLoopService,
  registers with transport.Server, listens on configured port, graceful shutdown with
  signal handling (SIGTERM/SIGINT), drain period with configurable deadline
- cmd/flexagent/serve_sandbox_host.go — 'flexagent serve sandbox-host' subcommand: migrates
  existing cmd/sandbox-host/main.go logic
- cmd/flexagent/serve_all.go — 'flexagent serve all' subcommand: runs agent loop +
  sandbox-host in-process (local dev experience)
- cmd/flexagent/serve_orchestrator.go — Placeholder/stub for future orchestrator subcommand
- Update Makefile to build cmd/flexagent instead of (or in addition to) cmd/sandbox-host
- Remove or redirect cmd/sandbox-host to flexagent (deprecation path)
- Unit tests for CLI argument parsing, graceful shutdown behavior

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §7, §7.1-§7.4, §13, §17
- Test harness: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md §12 (GS1-GS3)
- Depends on: aiag-rmv.3 (RPC transport — needs refactored transport.Server)
